main_measure.name: slope of drift-adjusted 20-bar forward return on abs(forecast), forecast<0 grid cells
main_measure.threshold: slope t <= -2 confirms (with supporting check); slope t >= +2 rejects

supporting_check.name: mean drift-adjusted 20-bar return over cases < 0 with day-clustered t <= -2

decided_by: Neither the confirm rule (slope t <= -2 with supporting check passed) nor the reject rule (slope t >= +2 or mean t >= +2) is met.
reading: Cases are grid cells at positions 0,20,40,... of each window with forecast < 0 and a full 20-bar forward return inside the window, drift is the coin's mean over that grid in all windows, the supporting t clusters deviations by UTC day, the same t is used for the reject rule's mean, and the plan's 30-case minimum gives 'not observable' when unmet.
